comment_data.body:
This was causing

```
cdef class NoWeakref:
    pass

cdef class Inherited4(NoWeakref):
    cdef object __weakref__
```

to fail (among other issues) because it never cleared but the weaklist because it didn't generate `tp_dealloc`

                 and not scope.has_pyobject_attrs
                 and not scope.has_memoryview_attrs
                 and not scope.has_explicitly_constructable_attrs
+                and not (self.slot_name == 'tp_dealloc' and scope.lookup_here("__weakref__"))

comment_data.body: Just to be sure... `tp_dealloc` will be generated in the `Inherited4` subclass , not in the `NoWeakref` base class, right?

+                and not (self.slot_name == 'tp_dealloc' and scope.lookup_here("__weakref__"))

comment_data.body:
It's generated for both.

The `NoWeakref` base class hits the "doesn't have a base class" rule so always gets `tp_dealloc`.
`Inherited4` gets its own `tp_dealloc` because of the `__weakref__` (which is the important bit for this test)

(The version here does unnecessarily generate `tp_dealloc` for anything that inherits from something that has `__weakref__`. Those are harmless, but in principle could be cleaned up. It's probably not worth it though. It'd need to duplicate some logic from `generate_dealloc_function`)
